selector: selectStintHistory(corpus, driverId, T, currentCompound, frameStintNumber, observedLap)
completed_stint: stint with end_observed_at_s != null and <= T; shows stint number, compound (entity, observed past), start-end lap range, lap count, COMPLETED
active_stint: stint with start_observed_at_s <= T and end not observed by T, matching the frame state's stint_number
active_stint_facts: compound from the causal frame state (never backfilled; null renders UNKNOWN), start lap (past-observed), stint age = observedLap - startLap + 1, ACTIVE
active_stint_never_shows: entity compound when frame compound differs
ambiguous_transition: frame stint_number null while stints underway -> activeUnknown, explicit unavailable text, never estimated
unplaceable_entity_stint: frame reports a stint the entity cannot place causally -> frame facts alone, explicitly partial
future_stints: hidden entirely, including their count; no 'stint k of N', no blank slots, no width/count-derived structure
tyre_age_terminology: STINT AGE only (observed laps in stint); raw FastF1 tyre_life includes other-session laps and is never relabelled

observed_example_2021_r01_hamilton_T4511.active: STINT 2 HARD lap 14-current, stint age 9, ACTIVE
